title: Monitoring Web Agents Without Internal Signals: Observable Trajectories and Key-Step Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2609.02057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable web-agent monitoring is difficult when model-internal uncertainty signals such as token logits are unavailable. In this work, we study prefix-level risk prediction for web agents using observable trajectory signals: given an evolving prefix, estimate whether the current execution remains on track or is tending toward failure. We derive two observable trajectory representations: Macro features summarize cross-step agent--environment behavior and feedback, while Micro features measure the consistency of intention, action, and anticipated state change through repeated black-box queries. Instead of inheriting the final result label, we label the first critical error that remains uncorrected in the observed continuation and is associated with final failure as a key-step boundary, preserving valid early prefixes of failed trajectories as on track. translated_title: 无需内部信号的网页智能体监控：可观测轨迹与关键步骤监督
translated_abstract: 当token logits等模型内部不确定性信号不可用时，实现可靠的网页智能体监控十分困难。在这项工作中，我们研究了基于可观测轨迹信号的网页智能体前缀级风险预测：给定一个不断演进的前缀，估计当前执行是仍在正轨上还是正趋于失败。我们推导出两种可观测轨迹表示：宏观特征总结跨步骤的智能体-环境行为与反馈，而微观特征通过重复的黑盒查询来衡量意图、动作与预期状态变化之间的一致性。我们不直接沿用最终结果标签，而是将观测到的后续执行中未被纠正且与最终失败相关联的首个关键错误标记为关键步骤边界，从而将失败轨迹中有效的早期前缀保留为“仍在正轨上”。在WebArena-Lite和Online Mind2Web网页智能体基准上，使用五个开源与闭源……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需模型内部信号、仅依赖可观测轨迹的网页智能体监控方法，通过宏观与微观轨迹特征及关键步骤边界标注实现前缀级风险预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a web-agent monitoring approach that relies solely on observable trajectories without internal model signals, achieving prefix-level risk prediction through macro and micro trajectory features along with key-step boundary labeling.
